import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Source file path(s)
    source_files = [
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_88/training_0.csv"
    ]

    # Target schema columns and types
    target_columns = ['Airline', 'Date_of_Journey', 'Source', 'Destination', 'Route',
                      'Dep_Time', 'Arrival_Time', 'Duration', 'Total_Stops', 'Additional_Info', 'Price']

    # Read all source files (only one in this case) and concatenate (union) since schemas are identical
    dfs = []
    for file in source_files:
        # Read CSV with index_col=0 to ignore the first numerical index column
        df = pd.read_csv(file, index_col=0)

        # Check if all target columns exist in source
        missing_cols = set(target_columns) - set(df.columns)
        if missing_cols:
            raise ValueError(f"Source file {file} is missing columns: {missing_cols}")

        # Select only target columns in correct order
        df = df[target_columns]

        # Ensure Price is integer type (convert if needed)
        df['Price'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Price'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)

        # Convert all other columns to string type (as per target schema)
        for col in target_columns:
            if col != 'Price':
                df[col] = df[col].astype(str)

        dfs.append(df)

    # Since only one source table with same schema as target, union is just that dataframe
    target_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

    # Write the result to the target path
    target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_88/target_multisource.csv"
    target_df.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
